comment: The PWA's iPhone start-up images (docs/notes/server/pwa.md, 'Start-up splash'): every current iPhone portrait size in CSS px and its device pixel ratio. scripts/pwa-startup-images.py draws one PNG per row into server/static/startup/ and writes head.html's links; the server's shell::every_startup_image_has_its_screens_size checks both. mark_share: the mark's width as a share of the shorter side (the launcher's splash); version: the links' ?v=, bumped when the PNGs change.
